scope: Audit whether noncommutative Grothendieck, little-GT, or 2-summing factorization yields the arbitrary-frame canonical POVM support gate while preserving the supplied 2-extendible Choi interface
overall_status: UNKNOWN: standard norm/state factorizations do not directly produce the required legal estimator POVM; no theorem proof or legal counterexample found

claims.exact_statement: For a fixed positive frame Q and legal supplied broadcaster B, if a finite AB POVM E_y and real estimators f_i(y) satisfy sum_y f_i(y) B*(E_y)=Phi(A_i) for every frame coordinate and sum_i w_i sum_y tau(B*(E_y)) f_i(y)^2 <= sum_i w_i, then the canonical POVM M_y=B*(E_y) satisfies S_d(Q)>=2 Tr_HS(Q Phi)-Tr_HS(Q).
assumptions: Phi is unital, trace-preserving, CP and Hilbert--Schmidt self-adjoint
B is a supplied symmetric broadcaster with both channel marginals Phi
Q=sum_i w_i |A_i><A_i| is a finite positive dual frame
claims.novelty_boundary: A support certificate criterion, not a construction of the POVM/estimators.
claims.costs: Exact finite-dimensional inequality; no acquisition or numerical cost.
claims.falsifier: An error in scalar t^2/p >= 2tf-pf^2 or in the estimator first-moment identity invalidates the gate.

claims.exact_statement: Any finite positive AB sub-POVM E_y with sum E_y <= I can be completed by E_0=I-sum E_y; pullback through the unital CP B* gives a finite input POVM whose normalized effects have ensemble barycenter I/d. Zero estimators on the residual preserve all unbiased first moments and quadratic estimator cost. A state-valued finite measure with barycenter sigma can also be completed after scaling by s<=1/(d||sigma||_infty), but its original contribution is scaled by s.
assumptions: B* is the unital CP adjoint of the supplied broadcaster
Sub-POVM effects are actual positive operators, not just a PSD Gram matrix
claims.status: internally proved exact finite completion lemma
claims.novelty_boundary: Explains the legal rounding interface; does not show Grothendieck factorization supplies sub-POVM effects.
claims.costs: Finite residual spectral decomposition; no optimization or measurement acquisition.
claims.falsifier: Failure of positivity or exact sub-POVM normalization invalidates completion.

claims.exact_statement: For A_d=diag(sqrt(d-1),-1/sqrt(d-1),..., -1/sqrt(d-1)), tau(A_d)=0 and tau(A_d^2)=1; the rank-one canonical support is 1 while the ordinary 2-summing norm squared of X->Tr(A_d X) from S_1^d to R is d-1. Hence unconstrained 2-summing data are not a dimension-free substitute for barycenter-constrained canonical support.
assumptions: S_d is the support over POVM measures with barycenter I/d
claims.novelty_boundary: Refutes this direct norm relaxation only; not a channel counterexample or impossibility of a refined rounding theorem.
claims.falsifier: A different normalization of the S1 duality or an admissible canonical POVM score above 1 would invalidate the stated ratio.

claims.exact_statement: The ordinary noncommutative Grothendieck sequence estimate for a Hermitian common frame returns a bound proportional to 2||sum_i w_i A_i^2||_infty; little-GT gives upper state domination of a Hilbert-valued map; the jcb theorem is relative to the jcb norm and returns state functionals. These theorem conclusions do not themselves provide one finite AB POVM, estimator unbiasedness, barycenter I/d, or the negative Tr_HS(Q) correction needed in the canonical support gate.
assumptions: Haagerup ordinary noncommutative Grothendieck and little-GT theorem interfaces
claims.status: theorem-interface mismatch established; no no-go for specialized refined Grothendieck arguments
claims.novelty_boundary: Scoped theorem-interface audit, not a literature-priority review.
claims.costs: Primary theorem-interface check only; no numerical search or acquisition.
claims.falsifier: A theorem-specific construction satisfying the legal estimator gate (G*) would overcome the stated transfer gap.

claims.exact_statement: The arbitrary-rank full-domain factor-two comparator and existence of a legal marginal-feasible counterexample remain unresolved by this Grothendieck/2-summing pass.
claims.costs: No external correctness review or acquisition.
claims.falsifier: A complete all-frame proof or a legal global moment-dual deficit changes status.

open_gate: Find a state/Gram factorization that rounds to an actual positive AB POVM with exact first moments and total estimator cost at most Tr_HS(Q), or retain UNKNOWN.
